round3_dispositions.evidence: The empty, typing, disconnected and reconnect-needed key fields show the placeholder "API key" (step-empty.png, step-typing.png). One state still lacks it, see F4-MB-2-1.
"Rakazo keeps your meetings and to-dos." is now the first row of the group (step-disconnected.png).

new_findings.description: In the Disconnected state the first row "Rakazo keeps your meetings and to-dos." breaks at the hyphen of "to-dos", leaving "dos." alone on the second line.
new_findings.expected: The sentence breaks at a word boundary that keeps "to-dos" together.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Use a non-breaking hyphen (to‑dos) or let the row text wrap before "to-dos".
